                                              • Deep dive 6 Nov ~11:50-12:10 UTC (checklist in CLAUDE.md). Sources: raeto.cc home, /developers, /build, /money, /earn, /rcredit, /analytics, /roadmap; their API api.raeto.cc/health, /v1/models, /v1/route/preview, /mcp; Robinhood Chain RPC event logs; npm registry; GitHub search; fxtwitter profile @RaetoCC.
                                              • Theirs: confirmed. Their own status page api.raeto.cc/health lists this address as the staking token ('staking': enabled false, token 0x72be..., rewardPct 25). The site links it only through a footer 'MCG Signal' link (mcgsignal.com/0x72be...). Launch wallet 0x047d5cad is also the wallet that made the first and largest vault deposits.
                                              • Product is live (checked 6 Nov): /v1/models lists 426 models; /v1/route/preview answered a test request (picked mistral-small, 98% cheaper than the top model); paid chat call without a key returns 402 (payment needed); MCP server asks for sign-in. npm @raeto/plugin-raeto (made 23 Oct, 708 downloads last month) and @raeto/game-plugin (24 Oct, 337). Card checkout on ($5-$1,000, 2.9% + $0.30).
                                              • Token's job: none today. /developers: 'Auto routing is open to every account; you don't need to hold $RAETO' and 'Only if Raeto turns a $RAETO holding requirement for auto routing back on; it's off today.' Staking is built but switched off (health: staking.enabled false). The 'burns' on the site are rCREDIT (their $1 credit token), not $RAETO.
                                              • Usage: USDG vault 0x6f9c9bd7 has had 7 deposits from 3 wallets ever. 0x047d5cad (the token's launch wallet) put in $9,928 on 13 Oct and took $9,000 out on 29 Oct; the other two put in $7 and $2.61. Daily interest fell from ~$1.10 to ~$0.10 after that (Harvest events). Health page also shows 115,436 billing receipts (1,273 in the 11:00 UTC hour, anchored on chain hourly; may include the free routing preview), 24 agents, 33 watched wallets with 0 on-chain payments in, Priors tool calls 11 since 3 Nov. /analytics says 'Coming soon'.
                                              • Money: 8% fee on model output, auto routing takes 30% of what it saves, $0.0002 per routing decision, 1.5% on Raeto Pay tool sales, 2% to cash rCREDIT back to USDG. No public revenue figures.
                                              • Team: anonymous. X @RaetoCC made 11 Oct 2026, 1,918 followers, 445 posts (6 Nov). Token launched on Pons 12 Oct 14:39 UTC. Launch wallet, treasury and keeper hold 0 $RAETO now (where the launch buy went: not checked). No public GitHub of their own (raetoRH/raeto-plugin made 25 Oct, 0 stars, not confirmed theirs). No audit mentioned. Payouts are 'checked by the Raeto team before sent'; rCREDIT move-out is 'paused right now'.
                                              • Scanner corrections: 'money goes back to the token (burns)' +10 is wrong: the burns are rCREDIT, $RAETO has no use today (score should be 70, not 80). 'Site offers API keys' shows a red cross although keys are offered (it is worth 0 points by design; the mark misleads).

                                                                                                                  DEX volume season: when on-chain trading usually picks up

                                                                                                                  Total DEX volume across all chains from DefiLlama (data to 06 Nov 2026, fetched 07 Nov 00:46 UTC), added up into weeks (Mon to Sun). Volume has grown a lot since 2021, so each week is compared with the typical week in the 6 months either side of it: +20% means 20% busier than normal for that time. That way 2021 and 2025 count the same. Years used: 2021 to 2025, plus 2026 so far (2026 is a midterm year in the US presidential cycle).

                                                                                                                  So far the season pattern has not helped predict the next month. Tested on 40 past months (2023 on, each using only data known at the time, all years): the season forecast was off by 25% on a typical month, the plain guess ("next month = last 8 weeks") by 17%. Season was closer in 13 of 40 months, and called up-or-down vs the last 8 weeks right in 17 of 40 (a coin toss gets about 20).

                                                                                                                  Hand review · 2026-11-06

                                                                                                                  What it does
                                                                                                                  AI assistant app that writes code, runs tasks, and builds and hosts apps. Pays for services from its own wallet.
                                                                                                                  Unique?
                                                                                                                  Partly. The pieces exist elsewhere; having all of them in one app with a built-in wallet is rare. Open source, so easy to copy.
                                                                                                                  Scalable?
                                                                                                                  Software yes (fast, light). Business unproven: 2-person team, paid servers, rich rivals.
                                                                                                                  Narrative fit
                                                                                                                  Strong: AI agents that pay for things. Weak Robinhood Chain link: only the token lives here.
                                                                                                                  How it makes money
                                                                                                                  Subscriptions ($20/month), a cut on AI models it resells, and hosting.
                                                                                                                  Token today
                                                                                                                  Does nothing yet. Buybacks and paying with LETRO aren't switched on.
                                                                                                                  Watch for
                                                                                                                  Buybacks starting · X followers (193 now) · team's last token fell 83% · unclear where its cheap AI prices come from (could be the team's AILE sharing market)
